nom: TULA Clear Up Pore Clearing Gel

avis.texte: I've been using this formula as a toner since it first came out several years ago. I'm well into my 60s now, and still had problems with occasional acne. I started using this before applying my moisturizer and I've seriously never had another pimple. I won't put anything other than Tula on my face and neck. I also use the 24/7 moisturizer and this combination has changed my life.

I started using this product in 2020 when I wanted to create a strong skincare routine. This product has been my stan since then! It helped my skin SO much through my pregnancy in 2022, and has been the one constant. I will ALWAYS recommend this!
It prevents blemishes! And keeps my skin looking healthy which I love !

I have been struggling with random breakouts on my upper lip, chin, and cheeks. No product or even popping seemed to get rid of them quickly. I have been using this gel every day, sometimes twice a day (morning and night) and I actually can tell a difference. I have had less breakouts, and when I recently felt a breakout under the skin above my lip, I put this gel on, and it never surfaced and just went away. I will be repurchasing!!

I struggled with a lot of fungal acne on my forehead or small bumps i think it was fungal acne at least! anyway i struggled with acne on my forehead and cheeks but after using this it has cleared my skin!! I still get acne here and there but never what it used to be!

The only thing that keeps my face clear. it feels a little sticky but it dries well and I use it under a moisturizer. Iv tried lots of toners / serums / retinols and this is the best ! Good for sensitive skin and doesn't end up ruining your skin barrier over time like other harsh acids. worth the money it last me a long time.

Please please bring this back. After 9 years of acne and going to a dermatologist who couldn't even cure it, this is the ONLY thing that finally cleared my skin. I've been loyal to it for 5 years back when the bottle was white/clearish and am so scared to have to find something new. I just ran out of my last bottle.

avis.titre: They've been saying for months it'll be restocked in 2 weeks
avis.texte: It's the best but I think it's time to move on. They've been saying for months it'll be restocked in 2 weeks. Never happens.
I've been using this product daily for years and it's the only product that helps with my hormonal acne and keeps my skin clear.

When will this product be back! I swear by this for 5 years now!!!!! I am a hormonal acne person on top on normal every day blemishes and toning problems this has saved my face and made my complexion near perfect! I recommend this to every woman! Please come Back!
